context: Tests whether the agent correctly plans a multi-decision feature using the DLD dld-plan workflow, including running next-id.sh before each decision, using printf with \n for body content, applying a consistent kebab-case grouping tag, and regenerating INDEX.md after all decisions are created.

checklist.name: Kebab-case tag applied
checklist.description: All new decision records share a common tag in their frontmatter `tags` field that is in kebab-case format (e.g., `user-auth`, `user-authentication`, `auth-feature` — not bare `auth` or `feature`)

checklist.name: Tag is feature-specific
checklist.description: The shared tag is specific to the user authentication feature — it is NOT a generic tag like `feature`, `auth`, `backend`, or `general`

checklist.name: All decisions share the same tag
checklist.description: Every newly created decision record has the same grouping tag in its frontmatter — no new decision records are missing the tag

checklist.name: At least two decisions created
checklist.description: At least two new decision records exist under `decisions/records/` (e.g. DL-002.md and DL-003.md)

checklist.name: INDEX.md regenerated
checklist.description: `decisions/INDEX.md` lists ALL decision records including every newly created decision (not just DL-001)

checklist.name: New decisions status proposed
checklist.description: All newly created decision records have `status: proposed` in their YAML frontmatter (planning stage, not yet implemented)

checklist.name: Incremental ID assignment
checklist.description: New decision IDs are sequential starting from DL-002 (i.e., each new record gets the next available ID, not a batch of IDs chosen upfront without running next-id.sh between each)

checklist.name: DL-001 status unchanged
checklist.description: The existing `decisions/records/DL-001.md` still has `status: accepted` — it was not modified by the planning operation

checklist.name: Records have well-formed section structure
checklist.description: Each new decision record body contains the standard sections (Context, Decision, Rationale, Consequences) as real markdown headings - not a run-on paragraph, and no literal backslash-n sequences left unrendered in the file.
